title: The Savings Account Paradox
hook: Checking your bank account after a "treat yourself" weekend.
script:
(Visual: Realistic AI-generated scene. Close-up of a person staring at a phone screen with a look of genuine curiosity, as if solving a complex math problem.)

VO: I just need to see where the money went.

(Visual: Cut to the phone screen. The balance is $4.12. The user scrolls up through the transactions.)

(Visual: Fast cuts of the transactions: "Artisanal Toast - $18", "Fancy Candle - $35", "Uber to a place I could have walked to - $12".)

VO: (Calm, analytical tone) Interesting.

(Visual: The person looks back at the $4.12 balance. They slowly put the phone down and lean back with a sigh of relief.)

Person: Well, at least I’m not spending any more today.
caption: Math is easy when you just stop looking. 💸 #LifeIsAGlitch #Adulting #FinancialStability #TreatYourself
